name: coachingos-monorepo
description: CoachingOS Monorepo — Frontend (Next.js) and Backend (Express REST API)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix backend"
